summary: Disable telemetry by upgrading the Helm release in YAML view and adding, under redhat-developer-hub.global.dynamic.plugins, an entry with disabled: true for ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-community-plugin-analytics-provider-segment; delete it to re-enable.
questions: How do I disable telemetry in self-service automation portal?
Turn off segment analytics in the portal

answer_card.title: Disable portal telemetry
answer_card.answer_md:
Helm release > **Upgrade** > YAML view, add:
```yaml
redhat-developer-hub:
  global:
    dynamic:
      plugins:
        - disabled: true
          package: >-
            ./dynamic-plugins/dist/backstage-community-plugin-analytics-provider-segment
```
Click **Upgrade** (the pod restarts). Remove the lines to re-enable.
